## Context / Problem
37 test modules (7,000 LOC, 486 collected nodes) pin one-time module splits as permanent invariants: re-export identity, "leaf" import shape, LOC floors and headroom, "shim no longer reachable". They fail on legitimate refactors and assert nothing about behaviour; 39 real behaviour tests are trapped inside them. The per-file verdict table with node counts is this ticket's first comment; the file list and every move are stated below. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
DELETE-WHOLE (git rm, nothing moves), 14 files: `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py`, `tests/scripts/test_mcp_server_seam_clean_heldout.py`, `tests/scripts/test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py`, `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_happy.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_inbound_apply_seam_split.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_module_seam.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_outbound_comments_split_import.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_paging_split.py` (paging drain stays at `fetch/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py:156`, ceiling at `fetch/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py:116`), `tests/unit/test_decide_ops_seam.py`, `tests/unit/test_gate_dispatch_seam.py` (its memo test duplicates `tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_assemble_memo.py:152,175`), `tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py` (ids frozen at `tests/interfaces/store/test_ensures.py:56`), `tests/unit/test_prompt_model_module_seam.py`, `tests/unit/test_signing_module_split.py` (baked fallback stays at `tests/unit/test_attestation_signing.py:152`), `tests/unit/test_structured_run_seam.py` (lean import stays at `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_optionality.py:89`).

DELETE-BUT-MOVE (move the named tests with their helpers, then git rm the source), 11 files: `tests/scripts/test_binding_lifecycle_grace_seam_clean_heldout.py` (2 tests to `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_binding_absence_lifecycle.py`); `tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py` (2 tests to `tests/interfaces/store/test_gate_source_threading.py`, which already imports `gate_source`); `tests/scripts/test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py` (4 bug-c0b9 `reconciler_repo_root` tests + `_noneditable_package_config_file` and `test_repo_root_precedence_is_preserved`, `test_reconciler_event_identity_env_override_propagates` to new `tests/unit/test_reconciler_repo_root_c0b9.py`; `last_pass` tests to `tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py`; invariants test to `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_invariants.py`; the tautological `test_owned_in_place_toggle_is_read_live` is dropped); `tests/scripts/test_reconciler_jira_seam_clean_heldout.py` (settings tests to `state/test_config_jira_wiring.py`, cutover tests + `_rebar_unimportable` to `test_rich_text_cutover.py`, pandoc test to `test_wiki_render_hardening.py`, all under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/`); `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py` (`test_log_level_resolution_is_preserved` to new `tests/unit/test_logging_level.py`; opcert test to `tests/unit/test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py`; mirror-guard test to `tests/unit/test_mirror_guard.py`; review-bot port test to `tests/unit/review_bot/test_rp04_s5_startup.py`; grounding tests to `tests/unit/grounding/test_harness.py` and `test_resolve.py`; the `REBAR_SIGNING_KEY` env test is dropped, the HMAC epic deletes that env var); `tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_floor_module_seam.py` (`test_det_checks_still_runs_all_eleven_checks_in_order` to `tests/unit/test_det_floor_clarity.py`); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_comment_dedup_seam_crossing.py` (2 tests to `apply/test_comment_id_acli_envelope.py`); `tests/unit/test_agent_call_seam.py` (git mv to `tests/unit/test_agent_call.py`, dropping `test_agent_call_clears_the_split_floor`, `test_agent_call_has_no_runtime_import_from_runner`, `test_runner_no_longer_builds_the_kwargs_dict_inline`, the `_loc`/`_SRC`/`_RUNNER`/`_AGENT_CALL`/`_SPLIT_FLOOR` constants and the `ast`/`pathlib` imports); `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_split.py` (3 tests to `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py`, reusing its `_codes` at `:135`); `tests/unit/test_config_resolver_seam.py` (3 tests + `_project` to `tests/interfaces/store/test_gate_source_threading.py` after `:177`, adding `from rebar import _config_resolvers, _config_sources` and `from rebar import config as cfg` there because the moved bodies patch those modules at `:140-164`); `tests/unit/test_gate_context_seam.py` (1 test to `tests/interfaces/store/test_agent_op_safeguard.py` after `:61`). Moved tests keep their docstrings; the imports their bodies need are added at each destination.

`tests/unit/test_processors_status_split.py`: the config epic's shim-removal story helpless-carnelian-megaraptor performs this file's move and deletion itself (it deletes the re-exports the file asserts, so it lands first): `test_status_fold_replay_equivalence` + `_apply_status` go to `tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py`, with the helper body rewritten from `processors_status.process_status(...)` to the bare `process_status(...)` that module already imports at `:10`. If that story has landed, the file is gone and this story skips it; otherwise this story performs exactly that move.

KEEP unchanged the 12 behaviour modules named in the first comment; in `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py` delete `test_cloud_send_path_prose_names_shared_codec_owner` (`:35-42`) and rename the file to `test_rich_text_seam.py` (unpaired held-out module). Destination paths under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` are stated at the current name; the reconciler epic's rename carries them. Landing rule for `tests/unit/test_signing_module_split.py` and `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py`, which the HMAC story fuchsia-wettish-leafbird also edits: whichever lands second finds the file deleted, or deletes what remains; no link is needed.

Node arithmetic over the 37 files (486 nodes) + `test_residual_drain_happy.py` (3): 301 deleted, 39 moved, 149 kept (12 kept files unchanged = 128; `test_agent_call` 12; `test_rich_text_seam` 9).

## Scope
In scope: the 25 deleted files, the two new files, the renamed file, and the destinations named above. Out of scope: every file under `src/` and `scripts/`, the `Makefile`, `pyproject.toml`, and every test module not named above (the CI-parity, check-script and import-scan modules belong to S2, S3 and S4 of this epic).

## Testing
Before: `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- tests | grep -E 'seam|split' | xargs pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider` collects 486 nodes (+3 in `test_residual_drain_happy.py`). After: the 12 kept files + `test_agent_call.py` + `test_rich_text_seam.py` collect 149 nodes; each destination module collects its prior count plus the moved nodes (39 in total); `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- tests | grep -E 'seam|split'` lists only the 13 kept `seam|split` files (`test_agent_call.py` no longer matches). `make test` runs the CI selection; `make verify` is lint + typecheck + that same selection and is the pre-push gate, so both are run. `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` beyond the marker-admitted entries already present on main. Both collect runs are recorded on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The 25 deleted modules are gone: `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- tests | grep -E 'seam|split'` lists exactly the 13 kept files.
- [ ] Every moved test collects at its destination by node id (`pytest --collect-only -q <dest>::<name>` for each of the 39 moved nodes) and passes there (`pytest <dest> -q`).
- [ ] 149 + 39 = 188 surviving nodes against 301 deleted, reconciled from the two `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 with no unadmitted `new` entry.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
